page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an AMD EPYC 9124 processor with 30 dedicated physical cores operating at 2.75 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 180 GB of system memory, providing 6 GB per core, alongside a bundled 400 GB NVMe SSD for local storage. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier capabilities in machine learning workloads, with LLM inference speeds for prompt processing and text generation ranking in the top 10% across small, medium, and large models. CPU performance is strong, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, as well as Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Memory performance is more moderate, with uncached large-block read and write bandwidths falling into the middle 50%, representing a potential bottleneck for memory-bound workloads that exceed cache limits.

This server is highly optimized for artificial intelligence workloads, including LLM inference, deep learning, and parallel compute tasks. The dedicated AMD EPYC cores and dual NVIDIA L40S GPUs offer high resource density, making it a cost-efficient choice for GPU-intensive operations without the overhead of larger multi-GPU clusters. It is also well-suited for database operations, software compilation, and multi-threaded data decompression.
